title: 20-Minute Haloumi Kaleslaw
subtitle: with Crunchy Croutons and Hazelnuts
description: Super fast cooking never looked this tantalising! Bake croutons and hazelnuts until golden, toss with crunchy kaleslaw and drizzle with the easiest dressing imaginable. Top with pan-fried haloumi for cheesy goodness.

steps.text: Prep bread and nuts: Preheat the oven to 200C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Tear the baguette into 1cm chunks. Put the bread in a single layer on one side of the lined tray, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Put the hazelnuts on the other side of the tray.
Bake croutons and nuts: Bake the bread and hazelnuts for 5-6 mins until the bread is golden and crisp and the hazelnuts are toasted.

Make slaw: Meanwhile, combine the country seasoning, 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tbs white wine vinegar in a large bowl. Cut the apple into thin matchsticks (see Kitchen 101). Add the apple and kaleslaw mix to the dressing and toss to coat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Pan-fry haloumi: Cut the haloumi into 1cm-thick slices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Remove the pan from the heat.
Serve up: Add the haloumi to the slaw and toss to combine. Divide the slaw among bowls, scatter over the hazelnuts and croutons and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Here's an easy way to cut an apple into matchsticks: quarter the apple, remove the core, then thinly slice. Stack the slices and cut into matchsticks.
